name: Compliant AI outreach template (example)
description: Buyer-configurable template for AI voice agents. The template carries no real org name, number, URL, or case ID — those come from the buyer's deployment config at render time. The agent may only state a contact reason whose evidence is already in the CRM ledger. Never use for legal threats, debt collection, or unverifiable claims.

reason_taxonomy.PRIOR_CONTACT: Requires a dated CRM activity (call/email/meeting) the callee can recognize. State the date and channel.
reason_taxonomy.INBOUND_REQUEST: Requires a logged inbound artifact (form, event scan, ticket, order). State what it was and when.
reason_taxonomy.PUBLIC_LISTING: Requires a public source already stored as evidence (directory, listing). Name the source, never invent one.
reason_taxonomy.REFERRAL: Requires a named referrer with a stored consent record. Name them only if the record exists.

policy.identity_block: Rendered from deployment config, never hardcoded: ORG_DISPLAY_NAME + one callback channel (CALLBACK_PHONE and/or CALLBACK_URL) + optional REFERENCE (ticket/order/case only if that workflow exists). If the buyer has no callback channel configured, the agent must offer do-not-call instead of inventing one.

segments.text: Hello {firstName}, this is an automated AI assistant calling on behalf of [ORG_DISPLAY_NAME]. This call may be recorded. Do you have thirty seconds to hear why I am calling?

Thank you. I am calling because [REASON per taxonomy, e.g. we spoke on DATE about TOPIC / you requested DETAILS on DATE / your public listing at SOURCE]. I am not calling with any legal authority and this is not legal advice. You can verify us at [CALLBACK_CHANNEL from deployment config][ and reference REFERENCE if configured]. Would you like me to continue, or should I remove your number?

Understood. I will not ask for sensitive personal or financial information on this call. If you are interested, the next step is a short human follow-up at a time you choose, and I can send details to an address you provide. Otherwise say stop and I will end the call and mark you as do-not-call. What would you prefer?
